display_text: Upgradeable Item (Black Abbot) ** Adds [[Blinding Embers| Blinding Embers]][[Blinding Embers| Blinding Embers]]: This weapon sheds tiny embers that can impair a creatures sight. If you roll a 20 when attacking and confirm the critical hit, the target will become blinded by a burst of fiery sparks.[[Category: Blinding Embers items]][[Category:Upgradeable items]]
raw_html: [[Upgradeable Item (Black Abbot)]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]][[Upgradeable Item (Black Abbot)]]: This item could be upgraded if you found a [[Item:Seal of the Black Abbot|Seal of the Black Abbot]] to combine it with.
